description: Flood Forecasting for Transportation Resilience: A Guide is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by National Academies of Science, Engineering, and Medicine. This report offers technical resources and organizational insights to support state departments of transportation (DOTs) in advancing their flood forecasting capabilities. The guide was developed with input from state DOT partners about the business processes, preparedness, and data requirements necessary to build a flood forecasting capability that can withstand disruptions. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – General, Landslides. Assets: Property, Transportation and Mobility, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
